# m.partners.benzinga.firms

<!-- Generated by `uv run python scripts/render_reference.py`; do not edit by hand. -->

The research firms behind Benzinga's analyst ratings.

Call it from a session `m`, made with `dm.MassiveSession()`:

```python
m.partners.benzinga.firms(*, sort=None, order=None, limit=None, filters=None)
```

- [Methods](README.md#query-methods): `fetch()`, `poll(interval)`
- Read from: REST
- `poll()` by default: `dm.PollMode.REPLACE`, which holds only the latest poll's rows, one row per `BenzingaId`

[Dataset index](README.md)

## Arguments

A linked argument follows its rule under [shared arguments](README.md#shared-arguments) on the dataset index.

| Argument | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [`sort`](README.md#sort) | Any field of the rows, such as `"name"`. Fields: any REST field under [Massive fields](#massive-fields). |
| [`order`](README.md#order) | The direction of `sort`. |
| [`limit`](README.md#limit) | The most rows to return, in total. |
| [`filters`](README.md#filters) | Further endpoint parameters, such as `{"benzinga_id_any_of": ["5f3ac1"]}`. Keys: `benzinga_id`, `benzinga_id_any_of`, `benzinga_id_gt`, `benzinga_id_gte`, `benzinga_id_lt`, `benzinga_id_lte`. |

## Plans

How recent the data is on each of Massive's plans, and how far back its history goes, as Massive's pages state them.

| Plan | Firm Details (REST) |
| --- | --- |
| Benzinga Analyst Ratings | Updated every 2 hours |
| Benzinga Analyst Insights | Updated every 2 hours |
| Benzinga Analyst Ratings Business | Updated every 2 hours |
| Benzinga Analyst Insights Business | Updated every 2 hours |

## Columns

| Column | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `BenzingaId` | String | The identifier used by Benzinga for this record. |
| `Currency` | String | Primary currency used by the financial firm, with some entries having null values. |
| `LastUpdated` | Instant | Timestamp indicating when the firm's information was last modified or verified in the database. |
| `Name` | String | The name of a research firm or investment bank which issues ratings. |
| `TimestampInsert` | Instant | When the library received the row, by the local clock. Rows that arrive together share it. It isn't Massive's time, and later rows can carry earlier times. In a `poll()` table, it's the time of the poll the row's values came from. |
